page.layout: One page, a title page. Centred lines in large capitals, from top to bottom: CANTICUM / MOSIS / DEUT. XXXII: 1-43. / ANALYSI (in script capitals) / EXPOSITIONIBUS / ET / DEMONSTRATIONIBUS / ILLUSTRATUM. Below, at the right: DAVID.
page.notes: The "ANALYSI" line is set in a decorative script capital style; it is transcribed as its letters. The "DEUT. XXXII: 1-43." line is printed with a space before the colon, copied as printed. The faint text at the very top of the page, above CANTICUM, is show-through or a faded header from the reverse and is not transcribed. Faint marks and specks on the page are not printed text. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
